I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'd rather you hear it from me now than find out afterward. If you see a fairer way to split the risk, tell me and I'll take it seriously.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
